text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. Let's work hard this
year.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Or, rather, let's work harder this year?
Since I'm
competing in harder races.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yup. This is the path I chose for myself...
choice_data_list_en: The Classic Triple Crown it is.
The Classic Triple Crown it is.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is the pinnacle
of the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If I can do well there, I'll be able to show
people
who I really am.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I have to make up for the
disappointment I
caused...

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text:
What?! City isn't gonna be running in the
Tiara
tour?

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text:
Man, I was really hoping to see her win
the Triple
Tiara...

At the end of last year, Gold City
announced that
she would compete in
the Classic Triple Crown
tour—but some
fans were disappointed by this
turn of
events.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Some of them even complained to my
modeling
agency. I got an angry call
about it from my
manager.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She gave me an earful about how the
Tiara makes
more sense for a model,
saying she'd already set
up work for me
based on it. Hell of a way to start
the
year.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So of course I pushed back—I was like,
"Shut up
and watch me!" Then I hung up.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Uh, sure, but what did you just call my

manager?
choice_data_list: マネジさんも納得する走りをしよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's run a race that'll satisfy Maneji-san too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh. Anyway...
Knock, knock...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City! Happy New Year!

We find ourselves joined by Yukino
Bijin—a
fellow student who seems to
look up to Gold
City. City's told me
about her a few times in the
past.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yukino? Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I heard you were on campus, so I had
t'come see
you... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you... Weren't you planning to go
home for
the holiday?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yup! And I'm back already, with
souvenirs too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Really? I hope you brought those yummy
cookies
again like last time.

I notice Gold City's expression ease after
Yukino
Bijin arrives. She has a soft spot
for those who
adore her.

I always worry about how uptight Gold
City can
be, so this might be a good
opportunity for her to
unwind for once.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What? But... haven't we got traini—
choice_data_list: パパッと遊んでくれば？
ユキノビジンはしたいことある？
choice_data_list_en: Why not go have some quick fun?
Go have some of the snacks.
Is there anything you want to do, Yukino Bijin?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh gosh, really?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna go check out the lucky bags
with City! I
can't ev'r figure out which
one t'choose myself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh—but I'd probably be gett'n in the
way mak'n
City hang out with me,
wouldn't I?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If you're busy, I'll just go mind my
business
elsewhere!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Trainer says it's fine, so let's go.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Holy smokes! Thanks a jillion, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but my hair's all a mess. I can't go
out with
City look'n like this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gimme a sec to go get ready!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Gosh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You and your suggestions.

Yukino Bijin tells me later that Gold City
let her
do whatever she wanted and was
"so kind and
cool" the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yippee! I'll bring the souvenirs over
here,
then!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I bought lots and lots, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I want both of you to try these Morioka

specialties! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What are you looking at me for? If
Yukino says
it's fine, then it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? City, you did ask for two boxes worth, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I thought the idea was to eat 'em with
Trainer
from the start.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did I? I guess I was planning it as a
way to say
thanks or something.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll go make some tea.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! N-no, I can't make ya go through
the
trouble alone! Wait for me, City!

So the three of us enjoy a relaxing time
together,
eating the souvenirs Yukino
brought while
listening to her stories
from back home.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, right now?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, my mom gave me some bath minerals, so I was think'n of try'n those out...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Bath minerals? What are those?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
They're these crystals you find in hot
springs.
When you dissolve 'em, it
releases all the good
stuff inside—it's
like hav'n a hot spring at home!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I think I've seen them before. Cool,
cool. Are
they a specialty of Morioka
too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Not ev'n a bit, hehe. My mom bought
too many
online, so she gave some to
me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whaddaya say, City? You'll have to
come to the
Miho dorm if you wanna try
'em though!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
They don't damage the tub, so the dorm
leader
gave me permission to use 'em so
long's I clean up
after.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I see. That sounds nice...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But I dunno. I do have training today...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, guess I'm taking a bath then.
choice_data_list: 今日は作戦会議だけだし、先に入っておいで
choice_data_list_en: We only have a strategy meeting today, so go on in ahead.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yay! ♪ Hot springs with City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, these are bath minerals? Looks
kind of
suspicious...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! We just put 'em in a pack like
this...

Later, Gold City returns to my office
looking
totally relaxed.
